title: Explicit derived coefficients in affine spectrum coordinates
statement: Let $X,X\prime$ be affine schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $g\prime:X\prime\to X$, let $K\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ and $K\prime\in D(\mathcal O_{X\prime})$ [def-pc-derived-category], and let $\phi:L(g\prime)^*K\to K\prime$ [def-pc-derived-pullback]. For each affine scheme $Y$, let $t_Y:Y\cong\operatorname{Spec}\Gamma(Y,\mathcal O_Y)$ be the canonical spectrum isomorphism. Set $K_0=L(t_X^{-1})^*K$ and $K_0\prime=L(t_{X\prime}^{-1})^*K\prime$. Write $g_0\prime=\operatorname{Spec}(g\prime.\mathrm{appTop})$. Naturality gives $g_0\prime t_X^{-1}=t_{X\prime}^{-1}g\prime$. The canonical composition comparisons [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition] therefore define $a:L(g_0\prime)^*L(t_X^{-1})^*\cong L(t_{X\prime}^{-1})^*L(g\prime)^*$. Define $\phi_0=a_K;L(t_{X\prime}^{-1})^*(\phi)$. These are constructions of objects and morphisms, with no data chosen from mere existence.
